scope: Spline electron DC refinement tight, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/dcfidref_el/tight/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
